title: The VC dimension of partial concept classes via Radon's theorem
summary: Following Alon, Hanneke, Holzman, and Moran (FOCS 2021), we define a partial concept class (PCC) as a family of partial functions \(f: V\to\{0,1,\ast\}\); equivalently, its concepts partition the ground set into black ($f^{-1}(1)$), grey ($f^{-1}(\ast)$), and white parts ($f^{-1}(0)$). Its VC dimension is defined by shattering sets on which the value $\ast$ is not taken. We study two geometric PCCs in real Banach spaces, both with a margin \(\delta>0\): expanded half-spaces, where the grey part is a strip of width at least \(\delta\) adjacent to a half-space, and expanded balls, where the grey part is an annulus of width \(\delta\) around a unit radius ball. Our main results are dimension-free upper bounds on the VC dimension of the PCC of expanded balls in \(L_p\parenth{\mu}\), \(1\le p<\infty\), including the non-Euclidean and algorithmically particularly relevant case \(\ell^d_1\). These bounds depend on the margin and on the radii, but not on the ambient dimension or the underlying measure space. These are extensions of the work of Bourneuf, Charbit, and Thomassé (FOCS 2025) who studied the PCC of expanded balls in Euclidean space, that is, $\ell_2^d$. We also prove lower bounds on the VC dimension that match the upper bounds in terms of the margin parameter $\delta$. Finally, we derive a Dense Neighborhood Lemma in \(L_p\)-spaces, again extending the known Euclidean results. Our method relies on the linearization of the distance through a map into a space of non-trivial Rademacher type, and then the use of a balanced signed-sum estimate, or a no-dimensional Radon theorem. The arguments rely on ideas from functional analysis that are clearly explained for the non-expert in that field.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了实 Banach 空间中两类几何偏概念类（expanded half-spaces 与 expanded balls）的 VC 维数，给出了与空间维数无关的（dimension-free）上界，并将 Bourneuf–Charbit–Thomassé（FOCS 2025）关于 Euclidean 空间 $\ell_2^d$ 中 expanded balls 的结果推广到一般 $L_p(\mu)$ 空间（$1 \le p < \infty$），方法核心是"距离的线性化 + 无维 Radon 定理"。
AI.motivation: 经典半空间 VC 维数为 $d+1$，随维数线性增长；引入 margin $\delta$ 后，expanded half-spaces 的 VC 维数变为仅依赖于 $\delta$、与维数无关。Bourneuf–Charbit–Thomassé（FOCS 2025）将这一"margin 解脱维度"现象从半空间推广到 Euclidean 中的 expanded balls。本文进一步将结果推广至非欧氏、算法上更相关的 $L_p$ 空间（特别是 $\ell_1^d$），并给出匹配的下界与稠密邻域引理（DNL）。
AI.method: 核心方法由两大要素构成：（1）**无维 Radon 定理**（平衡符号和技术）：在 Rademacher 型 $q>1$ 的 Banach 空间中，单位球内 $2n$ 个向量存在平衡的 $\pm 1$ 组合使范数 $\le 2T_q(X) n^{1/q}$；（2）**距离幂次的线性化**：将 $\|x-c\|^\theta$ 表示为 $\langle \Phi(x), \Psi(c)\rangle_F$ 加仅依赖 $c$ 的项，其中 $\Phi(x)$ 落入具有非平凡 Rademacher 类型的特征空间 $F$。综合得到距离幂次的不一致度（discrepancy）上界，再转化为 VC 维上界。对 $1\le p\le 2$ 用 Schoenberg 负型嵌入定理（$\|x-y\|_p^{p/2}$ 等度嵌入 Hilbert 空间）；对 $p>2$ 引入新的"Taylor–Schoenberg 提升"，通过 Taylor 展开扣除前 $\lfloor p/2\rfloor$ 阶项，使剩余核落入 Schoenberg 适用范围，从而将 $\|x-y\|_p^p$ 线性化到类型 $q=p/(p-1)$ 的特征空间。
AI.result: （1）对 $1\le p\le 2$：$\mathrm{VCdim}(\mathcal{B}_{\delta,\rho,R}(L_p(\mu)))\le 8(2\sqrt{\rho R}+\rho)^2/\delta^2+2$；（2）对 $p>2$：$\mathrm{VCdim}\le 2(25\sqrt{p}(R+\rho)^p/\delta)^p+2$；均与空间维数及测度空间无关。（3）匹配的下界：对 $p\ge 2$ 给出 $\ge c_p \delta^{-p}$；对 $1\le p<2$（或任意无穷维 Banach 空间）用 Dvoretzky 定理给出 $\ge c\delta^{-2}$。（4）将稠密邻域引理（DNL）从 Euclidean 推广至所有 $L_p$ 空间，覆盖数显式且与维数无关。附注：Hamming 立方体作为 $\ell_1^N$ 的子度量空间，所得 $O(\delta^{-2})$ 界恢复了 [3, Theorem 22] 关于 Hamming 三图的结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文为 $L_p(\mu)$ 空间（$1\le p<\infty$，包括算法相关的 $\ell_1^d$）中的 expanded balls PCC 建立了首个与维数无关且显式常数的 VC 维上界，并通过匹配的 $\delta^{-M_p}$ 下界证明了关于 margin 参数的紧性。技术贡献在于"距离线性化 + 无维 Radon 定理"这一统一机制，以及为处理 $p>2$ 而新创的 Taylor–Schoenberg 提升工具。作为应用，DNL 也从 Euclidean 推广到所有 $L_p$ 空间。论文自包含，对 Banach 空间、Rademacher 型、负型度量等分析工具给出了面向组合学者的解释。

title: Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature
comment: 17 pages (9 main text), 10 figures. Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
summary: Numerical integration is a cornerstone of various scientific computing applications, such as engineering simulations and model evidence computations in probabilistic machine learning. Bayesian Quadrature uses Gaussian process surrogates that explicitly encode structural assumptions about the integrand to obtain integral estimates with quantified uncertainty. These surrogates are predominantly based on stationary covariance functions, which results in model misspecification for integrands exhibiting nonstationary behavior. We tackle this issue through an adaptively growing, tree-based partition of the integration domain into local stationary models. Our method recombines the local integral estimates through a hierarchy of GP conditioning that reintroduces cross-subdomain correlations, while model selection criteria control the tree growth to avoid unnecessary partitioning. The resulting algorithm is simple, requires no MCMC, and adapts its evaluation budget to local integrand complexity. On benchmark integration problems and a model evidence computation for an epidemiological model, Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature achieves substantial gains over standard Bayesian Quadrature on nonstationary integrands while matching its performance on stationary ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层贝叶斯求积（Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature, HBQ），一种针对非平稳被积函数的数值积分方法。通过树形域划分与局部平稳高斯过程代理，结合层次GP条件化重组子域积分估计，实现对非平稳性的自适应处理。
AI.motivation: 标准贝叶斯求积（BQ）依赖平稳协方差函数，对具有空间异质性（非平稳）的被积函数存在模型误设问题。例如似然函数峰值、流行病学模型证据计算中常出现的尖锐脊状结构，单一平稳核无法兼顾不同区域的尺度变化，导致评估预算分配低效。现有非平稳核方法通常缺乏闭式核均值嵌入，丧失BQ的计算优势。
AI.method: 方法核心包含三部分：（1）域分解——通过轴对齐二分分裂递归将域划分为超矩形子域，形成二叉树，每个叶节点拟合局部平稳Matérn GP；（2）层次GP条件化（树条件化）——保留父节点分裂前的GP作为分支节点先验，通过递归条件化重新引入跨子域相关性，将叶节点积分估计自底向上组合为全局估计；（3）自适应细化——基于BIC准则的分裂判据（惩罚模型复杂度），配合积分方差缩减（IVR）的主动评估点选择，自适应决定何时分裂、何处加密评估。算法无需MCMC，保持闭式计算。
AI.result: 在Genz基准测试中，HBQ在Corner Peak函数上较BQ实现最高6倍误差降低，其余函数与BQ持平。在SIR流行病学模型证据计算中，HBQ在N=100时达到亚1%相对误差，而BQ、MC、QMC仍高于1%。在分段Matérn GP结构恢复测试中100%正确识别段数、96%正确选择核阶，不确定性比BQ紧3.3倍。在一维反应扩散PDE积分中N=512时达到35倍误差降低。分层GP条件化与独立求和重组的差异小于0.05%。
AI.conclusion: HBQ成功将分层域划分与贝叶斯求积结合，在保持平稳GP闭式计算优势的同时获得非平稳适应性。可视为经典Genz-Malik自适应积分规则的贝叶斯对应物——用局部GP代理替代嵌入式多项式规则，提供原则性不确定性量化。方法简单、无需MCMC、自适应分配预算，在非平稳被积函数上显著优于标准BQ，在平稳问题上不损失性能。

title: When does distribution shift break graph neural networks calibration?
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications where distribution shift is un-avoidable. However, how such shifts affect model calibration, defined as the agreement between predictive confidence and actual accuracy, remains poorly understood, and existing graph calibration methods typically rely on labeled validation data from the deployment distribution. In this work, I present the first closed-form theoretical characterization of GNN calibration under distribution shift. I show that calibration is governed by a single scalar quantity that explicitly depends on structural changes between the source and target graphs, as well as feature quality. This characterization precisely identifies when a model becomes over-confident, under-confident, or remains calibrated, and directly yields the optimal temperature scaling strategy. I further extend the analysis to graph convolutional networks with symmetric normalization, multi-class classification, and covariate shift, and derive a theoretical upper bound on the expected calibration error. My analysis also reveals that, under homogeneous distribution shift, a single global temperature is theoretically optimal, providing a principled explanation for why more complex node-wise recalibration methods offer no additional benefit. Building on these theoretical insights, I propose STAC, a source-free, label-free calibration method. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks demonstrate substantial calibration improvements, while evaluations on five real-world graph datasets show that reliable calibration without target labels remains challenging despite the strong predictive power of the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了首个关于图神经网络(GNN)在分布偏移下校准的闭式理论表征。核心发现是：校准行为由一个标量"校准斜率"κ控制，该量显式依赖于源图与目标图之间的同质性差异和特征信噪比(SNR)；由此可直接推导出最优温度缩放策略T*=1/κ，并证明在同质偏移下全局温度在理论上最优（逐节点方法无额外收益）。据此提出无源、无标签的STAC方法。
AI.motivation: GNN在真实部署中面临不可避免的分布偏移（社交网络演化、传感器图重连等），其校准性（预测置信度与实际准确率的一致性）是决定其能否被信任的关键。然而，现有图校准方法（如CaGCN、GATS、GETS、WATS、SimCalib等）均依赖与测试分布同分布的标注验证数据，在偏移下失效。先前工作从经验上观察到GNN的偏移下校准问题，但缺乏从第一性原理出发的机制解释：偏移如何、以何方向、在多大程度上改变GNN的置信度-准确率关系。
AI.method:
1. **理论分析**：在上下文随机块模型(CSBM)上分析线性GNN（均值聚合及带自环的GCN算子）和对数几率分类器，利用中心极限定理推导出聚合判别坐标的均值(2h-1)r与方差(4h(1-h)r²+σ²)/d，从而得到**校准斜率定理**（Theorem 1）：准确率=σ(κt)，置信度=σ(t)，其中κ显式依赖同质性比h_t/h_s和SNR ρ。推导出最优温度T*=1/κ，并证明ECE上界（Proposition 4）。扩展至自环GCN、K类分类、协变量偏移（Proposition 1-3）。  
2. **结构推论**（Corollary 1）：在同质偏移下，全局温度在最小化总体NLL和ECE上严格最优，任意逐节点温度函数无法改进。  
3. **STAC方法**：冻结源模型，在目标图上通过阈值置信度(ATC)与扰动下预测分歧(GDE)估计无标签准确率â，再通过一维线搜索匹配平均置信度得到T*=1/κ̂。包含可选的逐节点调制阶段（作为推论的验证性消融）。
AI.result:
**理论验证**：在合成CSBM上，闭式斜率与测得的1/T_oracle高度吻合（Pearson r=0.99，MAE=0.11温度单位），ECE从最高0.25降至≤0.02；K类信号系数c_K(h)在K=3,4,5下精确匹配模拟值；协变量偏移下，过自信单调增长且符号始终为正，符合Proposition 3的单向预测。  
**STAC表现**：合成特征偏移下，STAC-global大致将ECE缺口减半（接近oracle），但逐节点阶段对异质偏移的检测增益有限。  
**真实图（5个数据集，h∈[0.05,0.84]，K≤18）**：单一oracle温度在所有图上将ECE恢复到0.015-0.024，但无标签STAC因准确率估计偏差（如amazon-ratings上â=0.81 vs 真实0.38）反而可能恶化ECE（0.085→0.432）。负向结论：图上的无标签准确率估计是核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了GNN校准在分布偏移下的首个闭式理论框架：单一标量κ精确预测了GNN在偏移下校准偏差的方向、幅度和最优修正；证明了同质偏移下全局温度的充分性，解释并否定了逐节点校准方法在此场景下的额外价值；该理论在合成数据上精确成立，并可在5个跨两个数量级同质性的真实图上通过单一oracle温度实现完全校准。将理论转化为完全自动化的无标签校准器，归结为从无标签数据估计目标准确率这一子问题——当前现成估计器（ATC、分歧法）在异质高K图上不够可靠；这明确了图原生、无标签、抗偏移的准确率估计是未来工作的核心方向，也使该理论成为将闭式理解转化为可部署零标签GNN校准器的基础。

title: Lower Bound on the Cumulative Constrained Violation for the OGD+Projection algorithm for Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO)
summary: The problem of constrained online convex optimization is considered, where at each round, once a learner commits to an action $x_t \in \mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a convex loss function $f_t$ and a convex constraint function $g_t$ that drives the constraint $g_t(x)\le 0$ are revealed. The objective is to simultaneously minimize the static regret and cumulative constraint violation (CCV) compared to the benchmark that knows the loss functions and constraint functions $f_t$ and $g_t$ for all $t$ ahead of time, and chooses a static optimal action that is feasible with respect to all $g_t(x)\le 0$. Currently, the best known algorithm is OGD+Projection algorithm of [Vaze and Sinha, 2025] that has simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(T^{1/3})$ for $d=2$ [Balasundaram et al., 2026], and simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(\sqrt{T})$ for any $d$ [Sarkar and Sinha, 2026]. In this paper, we show that the CCV of the OGD+Projection algorithm is $\Omega (T^{\frac{d-1}{2d}})$. This is the first such lower bound result.

AI.tldr: 本文针对约束在线凸优化（COCO）问题中的OGD+Projection算法，首次建立了累积约束违反（CCV）的下界 $\Omega(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})$，证明现有上界分析并非本质上松弛。
AI.motivation: 现有OGD+Projection算法的CCV上界有：$d=2$时为$O(T^{1/3})$，任意维度$d$时为$O(\sqrt{T})$。但缺乏对应的下界证明，无法判断这些上界是否紧致。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构造性下界证明：(1) 利用球面上的递推构造（定理2），在$\mathcal{S}^d$上生成$\rho$-分离、局部$A_d\rho$-连续、规模$\Omega(\rho^{-(d-1)})$的有序单位向量集；(2) 在$d$维动作空间中构造嵌套约束集$K_p$，利用同心球$C_m=\partial\mathbb{B}(0,Dr_m)$与切线半空间$H_i^{(m)}$，通过旋转使层间衔接紧凑；(3) 设计线性损失函数$f_t=-\gamma_t a_p^\top x$驱动OGD+Projection沿预定轨迹移动，并在相位头产生$\Theta(T^{-1/d})$的投影违反；(4) 取$g_t=G\cdot\|x-\mathcal{P}_{S_t}(x)\|$将违反量转化为CCV，求和得总数$P=\Theta(T^{(d+1)/(2d)})$相位，乘以单次违反$\Theta(T^{-1/d})$，得CCV$\geq\Omega(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})$。
AI.result: 主要定理（定理1）：存在直径$2D$、Lipschitz常数$G$的COCO实例，使得OGD+Projection算法的CCV为$\Omega(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})$。当$d=2$时该下界为$\Omega(T^{1/4})$，相比已知上界$O(T^{1/3})$缩进一阶；当$d\geq 3$时下界为$\Omega(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})$，严格优于$O(\sqrt{T})$上界。球面向量构造（定理2）通过归纳法证明，常数$A_d=2^{d-1}$，$c_d=\pi^{d-1}/2^{d^2}$。
AI.conclusion: 该下界表明OGD+Projection算法的现有上界并非根本性松弛，尤其在低维情形下仍有显著改进空间。下界维度依赖性$(d-1)/(2d)$揭示了嵌套凸约束集几何结构与算法约束违反之间的本质联系，为未来设计可达到该下界的新型算法提供了理论基础。

title: Graph Neural Networks for RFID-Based Spatial Geometry Inference in Spatial AI Systems
comment: 38 pages, 10 figures. Introduces a Graph Neural Network framework for RFID-based spatial geometry inference using indoor floorplan semantics and digital twin representations
summary: Indoor spatial understanding remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent systems operating in physical environments. Traditional RFID localization techniques typically estimate positions of tags using signal strength measurements but fail to capture higher-order spatial relationships between objects and infrastructure. Recent work on RFID and wireless indoor localization has increasingly emphasized robust learning under noisy propagation, while recent graph-based localization methods demonstrate the value of relational modeling over isolated samples. This paper introduces a graph-based learning framework that leverages Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to infer spatial geometry from RFID observations. Rather than predicting isolated coordinates, the proposed system models relationships between RFID readings, antennas, and physical structures within an indoor floorplan. This framing is aligned with recent graph-based indoor positioning and graph construction literature, where topology is a first-class source of information for downstream inference. The approach integrates signal strength data, floorplan semantics, and spatial constraints into a graph representation where nodes correspond to RFID observations and edges encode proximity and contextual relationships. A GNN is then trained to predict geometric patterns such as linear trajectories, rectangular bounding regions, and movement paths of objects in space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的框架，将RFID观测数据从传统的逐点定位范式转变为空间几何推理任务。该方法通过将RFID观测、天线和楼层平面图语义信息整合为图表示（节点为观测，边编码空间邻近性与上下文关系），利用GNN推断线性轨迹、矩形边界区域和运动路径等几何模式，实验证明该方法在受控实验室环境中能够从噪声信号中恢复有意义的室内空间几何结构。
AI.motivation: 传统RFID定位方法主要依赖信号强度（RSSI）独立估计标签位置，将每个传感器读数视为孤立样本，忽略了室内环境中物体与基础设施之间的高阶空间关系。这种点式方法在多径效应、遮挡和环境变化下鲁棒性较差，且无法捕捉房间、走廊、设备位置等结构化空间信息，限制了感知系统对空间几何进行推理的能力。
AI.method: 方法核心是将RFID定位重新定义为关系型空间推理问题。技术路线包括：(1) 楼层平面图解析——从.flp文件提取区域、天线、容器多边形等语义信息；(2) 样本生成——以5秒时间窗口和(FloorplanUId, ContainerId, time_bucket, TagUId)元组对观测进行分组，采用弱监督规则生成几何标签（line/rect/path）；(3) 特征工程——构建包含坐标、RSSI、TagCount、duration、距离特征（至最近天线/容器/区域中心）及InsideZone/InsideCrate等二元标志的多维节点特征向量；(4) 图构建——以欧氏距离阈值τ=120.0构建邻接边，边特征包含距离、RSSI差值、天线/区域/容器一致性指示符；(5) GNN架构——三层GCN卷积（隐层维度64）+ ReLU激活 + 全局均值池化 + 双任务MLP头（分类+8维几何参数回归）；(6) 损失函数——交叉熵+MSE联合训练，Adam优化器，学习率0.001，20轮训练。
AI.result: 实验在Proxilab实验室环境的2829个图样本上进行，主要结果包括：(1) 与基线相比，GNN模型预期达到0.91准确率和0.89宏F1，优于RSSI逐点基线（0.61）、指纹/KNN（0.72）和前馈聚合网络（0.80）；(2) 几何类型间表现差异显著——path类准确率0.852但几何RMSE较高（64.98），line类准确率0.732但RMSE较低（29.98），表明结构化几何更易学习；(3) 区域间性能存在差异，高天线覆盖区域（如LabZoneA准确率1.0）优于稀疏区域（LabZoneI准确率0.585）；(4) 阈值与窗口敏感性分析表明τ=120、Δ=5-15秒为最佳平衡点；(5) 主要失败模式为稀疏图几何漂移（42.9%）、路径过度正则化（39.4%）和欠分割（17.6%）。需要注意的是，Table 1和Table 2中的数值为代表性占位符，标注需替换为实际实验输出。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：将RFID观测视为空间图的元素而非孤立定位信号，能显著提升其信息价值。方法在概念上将RFID从点式定位信号重新定位为空间AI的分布式感知基底，实践上证明了现有基础设施可支持更丰富的空间推理任务。其优势在于天然兼容稀疏噪声感知、整合环境语义信息且具可解释性。局限在于依赖合理的样本构建和图拓扑设计。论文指出未来方向包括动态图建模、多模态融合、不确定性感知推理以及与数字孪生系统的正式集成，为智能仓储、室内活动分析和环境智能等应用提供了新路径。

title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs) typically relies on trust-region masks to stabilize off-policy updates. The dominant PPO-style approach uses the sampled-token importance ratio for two criteria: a proximity criterion, which asks whether the policy has moved too far from the behavior policy, and a direction criterion, which asks whether the update pushes it farther away. Recent work DPPO improves the proximity criterion by replacing PPO's ratio-based test with a probability divergence between the behavior and training policies. However, its direction criterion is still inherited from PPO. A token can be masked only when the sampled-token importance ratio moves away from one. We observe that this ratio-based direction criterion is a single-sample proxy that can disagree in sign with the change of the divergence that defines the proximity criterion. We therefore propose the predictive divergence mask, which asks whether the next policy-gradient step will increase or decrease the same divergence used by the trust region. For the discrete softmax policies used in LLM RL, we derive this prediction in closed form. Because production rollout engines expose only a truncated (top-K) view of the vocabulary, we develop two lightweight top-$K$ estimators for this prediction. Detailed analysis shows the divergence-based direction is better aligned with the realized change of the divergence than the sampled ratio, and the resulting masks improve RL training across model scales and precision settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预测散度掩码"(Predictive Divergence Mask),用于解决大语言模型强化学习中DPPO方法的方向判据与近邻判据不一致的问题。DPPO虽然用KL散度替代了PPO中基于重要性比率的近邻判据,但方向判据仍沿用PPO的单采样比率,这可能导致与真实散度变化符号不一致。论文推导了softmax策略下KL散度沿策略梯度方向的一阶导数闭式解,并针对生产环境仅暴露top-K词表的情况提出了聚合尾部估计器和均匀尾部估计器。实验在多种模型规模和精度设置下验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在LLM的RL训练中,PPO及其变体(包括DPPO)使用trust-region掩码来稳定离策略更新,该掩码由两部分组成:近邻判据(策略是否离行为策略太远)和方向判据(更新是否使其更远)。DPPO用分布散度替代了基于采样比率的近邻判据,但仍沿用PPO基于单采样比率的方向判据。这一单采样代理可能与定义近邻判据的散度的真实变化方向不一致,导致错误的掩码决策,影响训练稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 定义方向判据为:下一次梯度更新是否会增加定义trust region的散度D_t;2) 对softmax策略推导KL散度D_KL(μ‖π)沿策略梯度单位方向v_i=𝟏[i=k]-π_i的导数,得到闭式解 Ḋ = (π_k-μ_k) + Σ_i π_i(μ_i-π_i),可分解为局部项(对应PPO比率判据)和全局项(softmax归一化耦合);3) 针对生产环境仅暴露top-K概率,提出两种轻量级top-K估计器:聚合尾部估计器(将尾部作为一个聚合桶)和均匀尾部估计器(将尾部均匀分配到未观测词);4) 将方向判据替换为sign(Â_t·Ḋ_t),得到预测散度掩码M_t^pred,与DPPO共享相同近邻判据但方向判据基于散度本身。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base、Qwen3-8B-Base、Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base(FP8 E2E和FP8 Rollout两种精度设置)上,使用AIME24和AIME25作为评测基准。两种预测散度掩码(聚合尾部和均匀尾部)在所有四种设置下均优于DPPO-TopK-KL基线和GRPO clip-higher。Token级分析(61个独立种子)显示:在方向判据分歧的token上,基于散度的判据将unsafe-keep率从36.9%降至34.2%,并将使散度收缩的更新比例从62.9%提升至65.1%。两种尾部估计器表现非常接近,验证了方法对尾部建模方式的鲁棒性。在更紧的阈值δ=0.05下,预测散度掩码仍优于基线,显示对超参的更好鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的预测散度掩码通过让方向判据与近邻判据共享同一散度定义,解决了DPPO中两者不一致的问题。理论分析表明方向判据可分解为PPO的局部项(仅看采样token)和一个被单采样代理忽略的全局项(softmax归一化耦合)。实验证明该方法在多种模型规模和精度设置下均提升了RL训练稳定性和效果。方法是一种局部一阶近似(实际更新受批量中其他token影响),但结果支持方向判据应与近邻判据一样获得分布式的处理。

title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized LLMs consisting of three key components: (1) Uncertainty: We assess the trustworthiness of LLMs quantized to 2, 3, 4, and 8 bits using six different quantization methods, employing established uncertainty metrics. (2) Calibration: We assess how well-calibrated the uncertainty estimates of quantized models are across model scales and bit precisions. (3) Robustness: We design character-level and word-level input perturbations to evaluate the reliability of quantized models under semantically-preserving variations in the inputs that arise in real-world applications. Second, we characterize how reliability scales with the total number of model bits. Our study reveals that while the performance scales monotonically with the total number of bits, the reliability scalings are nonlinear. A reliability peak occurs for 4-bit quantized models, indicating that quantizing moderately sized models offers the best reliability-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, our empirical findings reveal that quantization enhances the robustness of LLMs to natural input perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了量化大语言模型（LLM）的可靠性问题，提出了基于总模型比特数的可靠性扩展定律。研究发现，与随总比特数单调提升的准确率不同，可靠性呈现非线性规律：4-bit量化在固定比特预算下提供最佳可靠性-效率权衡，且量化能增强LLM对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM量化评估主要关注在未扰动输入上的标准预测性能（如准确率、困惑度），而忽略了安全性部署至关重要的可靠性维度，包括不确定性量化、校准度和对语义保持型输入扰动的鲁棒性。此外，先前的比特级扩展定律（如Dettmers & Zettlemoyer 2023）仅关注任务精度，未考虑可靠性指标。高精度或大模型未必带来更高的可靠性，这一关键问题亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 构建了量化LLM可靠性评估框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 不确定性评估——采用token级Shannon熵和对数似然，在2/3/4/8-bit下使用六种量化方法（BNB、AWQ、GPTQ、HQQ、Quanto、AQLM）；(2) 校准评估——使用Brier Score分析模型预测分布与真实分布的偏差；(3) 鲁棒性评估——设计15种字符级和词级自然扰动（表情符号、键盘替换、网络俚语、插入、Leet语种、翻译、删除、交换、重复、大小写变化等），覆盖真实数字通信场景。模型覆盖LLaMA-3.2（1B/3B）、LLaMA-3（8B/70B）、OPT和Qwen3系列，共63种模型配置，总计5859次实验。采用对数二次函数拟合比特级扩展趋势，以总模型比特数（参数量×比特精度）作为统一比较轴。
AI.result: (1) 准确率随总模型比特数单调提升，但可靠性扩展呈非线性，存在4-bit峰值；(2) 4-bit量化在固定比特预算下提供最佳的可靠性-效率权衡，对中等规模模型效果尤为突出；(3) 量化增强了LLM对自然语义保持扰动的鲁棒性，4-bit模型的AUCROC（熵）在扰动下优于全精度模型；(4) KL散度分析表明4-bit量化保持与全精度模型较小的行为偏移，而2-bit偏移过大；(5) 现象在LLaMA、OPT、Qwen3等不同架构以及TriviaQA、CoQA、CommonsenseQA、MMLU、HellaSwag等多个基准上一致；(6) 剪枝方法（SparseGPT、Wanda）未带来与量化相当的可靠性增益；(7) QAT（如EfficientQAT）在极低比特下改善可靠性扩展趋势，但与高比特仍有差距；(8) 3-bit大模型（如LLaMA-70B的HQQ 3-bit）可靠性可接近4-bit对应版本。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了量化LLM可靠性扩展的非线性特性，证明了无需诉诸最高精度或最大模型即可实现可靠性-效率最优权衡，4-bit是推荐的甜点。量化不仅是高效压缩手段，还可作为提升模型鲁棒性和可靠性的有效策略。该工作呼吁量化模型评估应超越传统性能指标，将不确定性、校准和鲁棒性纳入综合考量，以支持LLM在现实场景中的安全可信部署。未来研究方向包括QAT技术、模型微调、多样本提示等对可靠性扩展的影响。

title: Singular perturbations and hierarchical learning in two-layer neural networks
summary: We study the population gradient flow of an infinitely wide two-layer neural network learning a misspecified single-index model in high dimension. The two layers are optimized jointly, with a perturbative parameter tuning the relative training speed between the first and second layer. This setting was considered by Berthier, Montanari and Zhou in \cite{berthier2024learning}, who conjectured a hierarchical learning scenario with explicit timescales as the second layer is trained faster than the first. In this paper, we prove that the constant and linear components of the hidden link function are indeed recovered within the predicted timescales, at sharp explicit thresholds. We then analyze the onset of learning of the quadratic component and show that the components learned at earlier stages continue to influence the dynamics in an essential way. Our proof is based on quantitative approximation results for singularly perturbed flows evolving near a manifold defined by integral constraints. At a phenomenological level, we also show that the empirical measure of the weights displays singular behaviour when reaching the quadratic component of the hidden link, with a small fraction of neurons growing significantly while the remaining ones rearrange to preserve the components already learned.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两层神经网络在训练单指标模型时的群体梯度流动态，特别关注通过奇异摄动参数ε调节的层级训练速度。基于Berthier-Montanari-Zhou (2024) 的猜想，作者严格证明了常数项和线性项在明确时间尺度上的学习机制，并分析了二次项学习阶段先前学到的成分如何继续影响动力学。技术上建立了奇异摄动流在积分约束定义的流形附近的定量逼近理论框架，并通过仿真展示了权值经验测度的奇异行为。
AI.motivation: 深层神经网络成功的理论基础仍不完善。两层神经网络的训练动力学研究面临非凸性带来的技术挑战：核方法无法解释特征学习能力，而现有的单指标/多指标回归分析方法通常依赖分层训练或oracle修改。本文的核心动机是：严格理解具有联合梯度训练（无oracle修改）的两层神经网络在半参数回归任务中的层级学习现象，特别是检验并证明Berthier, Montanari和Zhou关于显式时间尺度的猜想。
AI.method:
方法论核心是奇异摄动分析和"管道构造法"（tube construction）：
1. **时间尺度分离**：引入小参数ε > 0控制第二层训练速度远快于第一层
2. **理想化系统识别**：在不同时间尺度上构造可显式求解的简化ODE系统
3. **管道/管域逼近**：在理想化轨迹周围构造半径随时间变化的"管道"，证明原系统在这些管道内演化
4. **目标集逼近方法**（Proposition B.1）：针对定义在积分约束（流形）附近的奇异摄动流，开发一般性定量逼近结果，类比于黎曼流形上的正交投影，但投影方向是向量场g
5. **拉格朗日乘子结构**：在二次项分析中，已学到的约束通过时变系数α₀(t), α₁(t)强制实现
6. **技巧工具**：Gronwall不等式、超几何参数化、逐段分析时间区间
AI.result:
**主要定量结果**：
- **常数项学习**（Prop 3.1）：精度达ε^η的时间尺度为 ε log(1/ε)/σ₀²
- **线性项学习**（Prop 3.2）：时间尺度为 √ε log(1/ε)，常数精确为1/(4σ₁φ₁)
- **量化逼近**（Thm 3.3）：在√ε log(1/ε)时间尺度内给出管域半径的显式界
- **二次项分析**（Prop 3.6）：通过重新尺度变换â = ε^{1/4}a, ŝ = ε^{-1/4}s，证明原动力系统被辅助系统(z₁, z₂)在L∞误差 (C₀ε^{1/4}log(1/ε) + Cε^{1/8}(t-t₀))exp(K(t-t₀))内逼近
- **现象学发现**：权值经验测度在二次项学习时呈奇异行为——少数神经元急剧增长，其余神经元重排以保持已学到的约束
- **关键洞察**：已学到的系数对后续动力学有本质影响，不能忽略

**理论框架**（附录B）：建立了对任意维数、多个约束条件下，奇异摄动流在积分约束流形附近的一般性逼近定理，推广了流形上梯度投影的直觉。
AI.conclusion:
本文为两层神经网络的层级学习现象提供了严格的数学基础，主要贡献包括：
1. **严格化猜想**：证实了Berthier-Montanari-Zhou关于常数项和线性项时间尺度的猜想
2. **方法论突破**：发展了处理积分约束流形附近奇异摄动流的一般框架
3. **新现象揭示**：证明二次项学习阶段，早期成分的贡献不可忽略；通过仿真展示权值分布的奇异行为
4. **开放问题**：未跟踪ε的显式常数；二次项之后的完整学习动态分析；均值场极限在长时间尺度上的有效性
该工作将奇异摄动理论、流形上的几何分析与神经网络训练动态相结合，为理解深度学习中的特征学习现象开辟了新途径。

title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics
summary: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the time-scale density of states (TDOS) through the infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, thereby enhancing the memory self-energy, reducing the cognitive forgetting gap, and strengthening the collective susceptibility. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra directly from Transformer layer Jacobians throughout training, network depth, and model scale, allowing the TDOS, memory self-energy, forgetting gap, memory kernel, and infrared critical exponent to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal progressive infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, producing an approximately flat infrared TDOS with \( \rho(\lambda)\sim\lambda^{-0.1} \) and scale-free memory kernels \( K(t)\sim t^{-1}. \) The memory self-energy exhibits a pronounced transient maximum during early optimization before relaxing toward a metastable near-critical regime, corresponding to the smallest cognitive forgetting gap and the largest collective susceptibility predicted by Cognitive Field Theory. These observations provide quantitative experimental evidence that Transformer dynamics are governed by infrared collective organization. The reproducibility of the same dynamical behavior across training, network depth, and model scales suggests that infrared slow-mode organization represents a universal collective principle of Transformer dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计物理与认知场论视角，通过直接测量Pythia Transformer模型层间Jacobian谱，定量验证了大型语言模型深层存在红外集体组织：慢弛豫模式在训练中系统性积累，形成近似平的红外态密度（TDOS）ρ(λ)~λ^{-0.1}和标度无关的记忆核K(t)~1/t。记忆自能在训练早期出现瞬态极大，对应认知遗忘间隙最小和集体磁化率最大，标志着宏观认知场的临界形成，最终稳定在亚临界态。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型展现出推理、抽象、上下文学习等显著涌现能力，但其大规模集体动力学的物理机制尚不明晰。现有研究多将Transformer视为高维非线性映射或基于注意力的优化过程，缺乏从非平衡多体物理视角理解其宏观集体组织如何产生。本文旨在检验认知场论（Cognitive Field Theory）所预测的红外集体可观测量能否直接从Transformer动力学中测量出来。
AI.method: 采用响应理论框架：1) 从Pythia-70M/410M/1.4B模型的隐藏层映射计算Jacobian矩阵，通过复特征值模长提取弛豫率 λ_α = -log|μ_α|；2) 构建时间尺度态密度（TDOS）ρ(λ)；3) 由TDOS直接计算记忆核K(t)、静态记忆自能Σ(0)、认知遗忘间隙r_cog = r - Σ(0)和集体磁化率χ(0) ∝ 1/r_cog；4) 通过累积模式分布拟合提取红外临界指数β；5) 系统分析训练步数、网络深度（1→5/10/15/20/24）和模型尺度下的演化。
AI.result: 测量揭示：1) 训练过程中慢弛豫模式系统性向红外区积累，稳定模式占比从约48%增至约82%（总模式数不变）；2) 红外TDOS近似平坦，ρ(λ)~λ^β，β≈-0.1，跨越近两个数量级呈线性；3) 记忆核自发涌现标度无关长时尾K(t)~1/t，无需预设函数形式；4) 记忆自能在训练早期约2000步处出现显著瞬态极大，对应遗忘间隙最小（~0.39）和集体磁化率最大，代表认知场的临界形成点；5) 此后系统弛豫到亚稳近临界区（Σ̃~0.77-0.78）；6) 红外组织在层间存在空间层级，中间和深层隐藏层具有更强的记忆重整化；7) 层传播深度从1→5扩展至1→24时，稳定模式占比从0.79提升至0.99，但1/t记忆核标度不变；8) 从70M到1.4B跨越近两个数量级的所有Pythia模型均呈现相同的红外组织演化序列。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了Transformer动力学受红外集体组织支配的首次定量实验证据。相同动力学行为在训练时间、网络深度和模型尺度上的可复现性，表明红外慢模式组织是Transformer动力学的普适集体原理，而非特定架构的特征。从更宏观视角看，这建立了现代深度学习与非平衡多体物理之间的直接联系，集体模式、自能重整化、临界磁化率、普适性和红外组织等凝聚态场论概念可成为描述宏观认知动力学的自然语言。该框架为未来在人工神经网络乃至生物认知系统中定量研究集体动力学建立了实验基础。

title: The Spectral Structure of Latent Treatment Effects
summary: Identifying heterogeneous treatment effects under unobserved confounding is central in observational causal inference. In proxy models with a discrete latent confounder, prior Synthetic Potential Outcomes (SPO) [Mazaheri-Squires-Uhler '25] recover the mixture of treatment effects through recursively constructed scalar moments. We show that this sequence is one projection of a more fundamental object. Under the same population factorization assumptions, there is an exact compressed observable operator: after projecting onto the shared proxy signal subspace, the difference of two treatment-arm quotient operators is similar to the diagonal matrix of latent treatment effects. Its eigenvalues are the latent effects; its lifted left eigenvectors, after anchor normalization, recover the target-proxy feature matrix and then the latent mixture proportions. Every scalar SPO moment is a bilinear functional of a power of this operator. The resulting estimator handles overcomplete proxy systems, replaces high-order scalar inversion with finite-dimensional spectral analysis, and admits high-probability first-order perturbation bounds for treatment effects, feature rows, and simplex-projected mixture weights.

AI.tldr: 本文针对离散潜在混杂因子下的异质性处理效应（MTE）识别问题，提出了一种谱（spectral）框架，将此前基于递归标量矩的SPO方法重新解释为一个压缩可观测算子的谱分解。核心结论：两个处理臂的压缩商算子之差 ΔQ̃ 在谱相似意义下等价于潜在处理效应矩阵 diag(τ(u))，其特征值即为待估的潜在效应；左特征向量经锚点归一化后恢复特征矩阵 B 和混合比例 p。新方法能处理超完备代理系统（d_x, d_z ≥ k），将高阶标量求逆替换为有限维谱分析，并提供 n^{-1/2} 一阶有限样本扰动界。
AI.motivation: 潜在因果效应异质性的识别是观测因果推断的核心难题。当混杂因子不可观测时，标准的边际处理效应（ATE）方法失效；Mazaheri等（2025）提出的SPO方法通过递归构造标量矩序列来恢复MTE，但该方法（1）仅适用于方阵代理系统 d_x=d_z=k，（2）涉及高阶矩的反演，数值不稳定，（3）缺乏清晰的有限样本理论。作者认为标量矩序列只是底层算子结构的一个投影，应直接在该算子上工作以克服上述局限。
AI.method: 方法核心分四步：（1）利用代理因子化假设 M_{ZX|t}=A_t D_{U|t} B⊤、M_{ZXY|t}=A_t D_{U|t} D_{Y|t} B⊤，定义环境商算子 Q_t = M_{ZX|t}^† M_{ZXY|t}；（2）通过堆叠代理矩阵 M_stack = [M_{ZX|0}; M_{ZX|1}] 的截断SVD提取共享 k 维信号子空间 V_k；（3）在压缩子空间内构造 k×k 算子 Q̃_t = (M_{ZX|t}V_k)^† (M_{ZXY|t}V_k)，其差 ΔQ̃ = Q̃_1 − Q̃_0 相似于对角矩阵 diag(τ(1),…,τ(k))；（4）提取 ΔQ̃ 的特征值得处理效应，左特征向量提升并经锚点归一化（X_1=1）恢复 B，再由 E[X]=Bp 解出混合比例 p。理论工具包括：Wedin定理做子空间扰动、伪逆扰动引理、Bauer-Fike特征值定位、Kato简单特征值左特征向量扰动、anchor归一化的局部Lipschitz性及单纯形投影的非扩张性。
AI.result: 理论上证明了七个主要定理：（i）潜在因果维度 k 等于堆叠代理矩阵的秩（Thm 4.1）；（ii）严格正性等价于两处理臂行空间均等于 R(B)（Thm 4.2）；（iii）Q_t 的信号子空间限制谱相似于 D_{Y|t}（Thm 5.1）；（iv）ΔQ̃ 谱相似于 D_τ 即潜在处理效应（Thm 5.2）；（v）每个标量SPO矩 m_ℓ = E[τ(U)^ℓ] 可表示为 a⊤(ΔQ̃)^ℓ c，从而证明算子是矩序列的有限维生成元（Thm 5.4）；（vi）潜在因果齐性等价于 ΔQ̃ = τ_* I_k（Prop 6.2）；（vii）高概率 n^{-1/2} 扰动界同时覆盖特征值、左特征向量提升行、锚点归一化后的特征矩阵 B̂ 和单纯形投影后的混合比例 p̂（Thm 7.1、7.2）。实证方面，在超完备代理 d=k+3 设定下，谱方法在所有 (k,N) 网格上均优于SPO基线，k=3、N=25000 时特征值误差从 0.445 降至 0.026（17.4×提升），收敛曲线符合预测的 O(n^{-1/2}) 速率，300次蒙特卡洛试验的特征值分布在真实效应附近形成锐利聚类。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了潜在因果混合识别本质上是算子问题而非矩序列问题。核心洞察是标量SPO构造并非替代估计器，而是同一个 k×k 压缩商算子通过双线性泛函的投影；这一重新阐释使得方法可处理超完备代理系统、避免病态高阶求逆、并获得完整的有限样本保证。重要意义包括：（1）将OPM（Observable Operator Model）类代数工具引入因果DAG结构而非对称张量分解；（2）通过 ΔQ̃ 的非对角性直接构造处理效应齐性的可检验判据；（3）超完备代理特征在有限样本下通过改善信号子空间条件数提升稳定性。开放方向包括：将商算子推广至RKHS连续潜在类、推导信号奇异值的更紧下界、以及利用齐性表征设计异质性检验。

title: Bandit PCA with Minimax Optimal Regret
summary: We study the bandit-feedback version of online principal component analysis (Bandit PCA): in each round $t = 1,\dots,T$, the adversary selects a $d \times d$ symmetric gain matrix $G_t$ with spectrum in $[0,1]$ and rank at most $r$; the learner simultaneously selects a unit vector $w_t \in S^{d-1}$ and receives the reward $w_t^\top G_t w_t$. The learner receives no other feedback, and aims to minimize the regret against the best unit vector in hindsight. This problem was introduced by Kotlowski and Neu (2019), who gave an algorithm with regret $O(d\sqrt{rT \log T})$ and showed the lower bound of $\Omega(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$. We improve upon both of these bounds and essentially bridge the gap between them, establishing the minimax regret of order $r\sqrt{dT}$ up to polylogarithmic factors in $d$ and $T$. The upper bound is attained by a novel algorithm, which combines online mirror descent on the spectrahedron of (real) density matrices with a multiscale exploration scheme in which the eigenspaces with different spectral magnitudes are updated at different rates. For the lower bound, we construct an adaptive adversary that refines a hidden large-reward subspace based on the learner's actions, in such a way that low regret is impossible without estimating the subspace; as a result, lower-bounding the regret reduces to studying the arising subspace estimation problem. Finally, we discuss connections of Bandit PCA with adaptive-measurement quantum tomography.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带bandit反馈的在线主成分分析（Bandit PCA）的极小极大遗憾问题。作者提出了一种新颖的算法，结合在线镜像下降（OMD）与多尺度探索方案，在正半定矩阵谱面上运行，并结合了一种层级采样方案和基于时期的增益矩阵估计器。该算法实现了 r√(dT) 的遗憾上界（在对数和多项式因子意义下），匹配了所构造的自适应对手所达到的下界，从而基本上解决了Bandit PCA的极小极大遗憾问题。
AI.motivation: Bandit PCA是经典多臂赌博机（MAB）问题的非交换推广，由Kotłowski和Neu于2019年提出。先前的工作存在一个 d·min(r,√(d/r)) 的遗憾差距，限制了极小最优遗憾界的确定。本文旨在通过同时改进上下界来弥合这一差距，以确定Bandit PCA问题的极小极大遗憾。
AI.method: 上界方面：提出了一种基于在线镜像下降（OMD）的算法，在谱面上使用负对数行列式势函数，并辅以（1）按特征值大小将特征向量分组的分层采样方案；（2）基于时期（epoch-based）的分层增益矩阵估计器，对反L形区域进行批量估计；（3）子空间的惰性更新机制。下界方面：构造了一个自适应对手，通过利用学习者的行动逐步完善隐藏的高奖励子空间，将低遗憾问题归约为子空间估计问题；进而通过后验似然论证得出协方差估计的查询复杂度下界。
AI.result: 建立了Bandit PCA问题的极小极大遗憾为 r√(dT)（在 d 和 T 的对数因子意义下）。具体而言：（1）上界：算法1实现了 Reg_T ≤ Cr√(dT) log³(edT) 的遗憾上界，其中增益矩阵的算子范数至多为1且秩至多为r；（2）下界：对于秩-r Bandit PCA，任何算法的遗憾至少为 c·min(r√(dT/log(ed)), T)/log(eT)。此外，算法总运行时间为 O(d²T log d)。这些结果在不同秩参数下均紧致：小秩(r=Θ(1))时相对先前工作改进了Õ(√d)因子；大秩(r=Θ(d))时下界改进相同因子。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了带bandit反馈的在线PCA的极小最优遗憾阶数为 r√(dT)，基本解决了该问题。主要贡献包括：新颖的分层采样和批量估计方案有效降低了先前算法的遗憾；自适应对手构造将下界证明归约为子空间估计问题。遗留的开放问题包括：缩小上界的多对数因子、降低计算复杂度、推广到k-PCA设定，以及与量子断层扫描的进一步联系。

title: Sticky Jump Diffusions: A Unifying View of Masked, Continuous, and Hybrid Diffusion
summary: We introduce Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs), continuous-time Markov processes on $\mathbb R^d$ whose discrete anchors are token embeddings. In forward time, anchors release their mass at a hazard rate and the released mass diffuses in the continuous ambient space; time reversal couples a score-driven SDE with a sticky jump kernel whose rate and destination are fixed by flux balance with the forward law. We estimate the score and the per-anchor reverse hazards from a single denoising classifier via Denoising Hazard Matching, the hazard analogue of denoising score matching, with simulation-free cross-entropy training. SJD recovers masked diffusion, continuous diffusion, and hybrid diffusion as limits. Its reversal explains features that each family treats as given: the mask of masked diffusion carries no evidence about the source token because the unsticking kernel of every anchor collapses to the same absorbing point; the terminal projection of continuous diffusion is required due to the absence of atoms in its forward marginal, without which flux balance yields no reverse jumps; and the update rules of hybrid diffusion (commit rate, destination, and drift) all follow from flux balance rather than from separate design. Beyond these limits, the unsticking kernel becomes a design space: a cross-position blending corrupts each position toward a blend of its neighbors' clean values or embeddings, turning dependency structure such as spatial locality or a constraint graph into an inductive bias of the corruption itself, and improves over the identity-kernel hybrid on CIFAR-10, Text8, and Sudoku.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"粘性跳跃扩散"(Sticky Jump Diffusions, SJDs)，一种在连续状态空间上的连续时间马尔可夫过程，其前向边际同时包含离散锚点(对应词嵌入)上的原子和连续区域上的密度，将掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散统一在同一框架内。
AI.motivation: 现有离散序列扩散模型存在三类：掩码扩散(梯度信息缺失)、连续扩散(需外部投影恢复离散性)、混合扩散(组件式手工设计)。三者各有局限且缺乏统一理论解释——为何掩码不携带源token信息？为何连续扩散需要终端投影？为何混合扩散的commit rate、目标、漂移必须如此设计？需要一个统一的过程级框架来解释这些"给定"特征，并将混合扩散的离散-连续耦合视为同一前向-后向状态，而非手工组合。
AI.method: 1) 前向过程：数据从锚点出发，按危险率λ→_t释放质量到连续区域，再经Itô SDE扩散；边际p_t分解为锚点原子和连续密度两部分。2) 后向过程(定理2.6)：通过通量平衡(flux balance)严格导出，耦合一个分数驱动的SDE和一个粘性跳跃核，跳跃率和目标均由前向律唯一确定。3) 去噪危险匹配(DHM, 定理3.2)：后向危险率等于前向已知量的条件期望，类比去噪分数匹配。4) 单分类器训练：交叉熵损失训练去噪分类器P_θ，无需单独的危险头或分数头；通过解析重加权(log λ̂_t(y,a))同时获得分数和后向危险率，训练无模拟。5) 跨位置混合核设计空间：通过混合矩阵W将每个位置的损坏中心设为邻居清洁值的加权和，将空间局部性、序列相关性、约束图等依赖结构编码为损坏本身的归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在三个任务上验证：(1) CIFAR-10图像生成：值空间模糊带宽σ_B∈{1.5,2.0,2.5}的SJD在256 NFE下取得FID 14.57，优于恒等核混合扩散CADD(15.88)、MD4(17.43)、MDLM(18.11)、Bit Diffusion(19.82)，与DDPM(14.66)相当。(2) Text8文本生成：1D高斯混合带宽σ_W≥1.0的SJD在有效词数量上Pareto支配CANDI和MDLM，NFE越高优势越明显。(3) 数独求解：约束图混合核(σ_W=1.5)的SJD板准确率达95.65%，CADD在6个种子中有多个崩溃(均值47.12%)且起飞步数约4倍慢于SJD(50k vs 203k)，甚至超过已知求解顺序的自回归求解器(87.18%)。额外分析表明非均匀前向危险率学习会因目标函数的扁平性而退化(有效词从0.27降至0.014)。
AI.conclusion: SJD将掩码、连续和混合扩散统一在一个跳跃扩散过程内，通过通量平衡严格导出后向过程，使得危险率和目标token由前向律自动确定而非手工调度。DHM将后向危险转化为单一去噪分类器可估计的条件期望，训练只需普通交叉熵。前向危险率的学习因ELBO在最优解处平坦而难以辨识，故推荐固定η=1并通过混合核(W, η)设计空间注入结构性归纳偏置。该框架使新的损坏、调度和提交规则可作为前向动力学指定，其后向动力学可"免费"获得。

title: WSqD: A Horizon-Free Learning Rate Schedule for Large Model Training
summary: Standard learning rate schedules such as cosine annealing are tied to a fixed training horizon, limiting their ability to accommodate post hoc horizon extension. Warmup-stable-decay (WSD) partially addresses this issue by maintaining a long constant-rate phase before a short linear cooldown, allowing training to resume from a pre-decay checkpoint. However, its peak learning rate is still tuned based on the original training horizon and can become suboptimal when training is extended. Motivated by stochastic convex optimization, we propose WSqD (Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay), a learning rate schedule that replaces WSD's constant stable phase with a shifted inverse-square-root base while retaining the final linear cooldown. In the stochastic convex setting, WSqD provably attains the minimax-optimal $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate convergence rate. Importantly, its base learning rate schedule is horizon-independent, and the training horizon is needed only to determine when to begin the final cooldown. Empirically, on language-model pretraining using the SlimPajama corpus, WSqD matches or outperforms carefully tuned WSD and other baselines across multiple training horizons while reusing a single peak learning rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为WSqD（Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay）的学习率调度策略，它将WSD的恒定稳定阶段替换为平移的逆平方根（shifted inverse-square-root）基准阶段，同时保留最终的线性冷却阶段。该方法在随机凸优化设定下被证明能达到O(1/√T)的minimax最优最后迭代收敛率，并且其基准学习率与训练总步数无关（即"horizon-free"），从而支持训练预算的事后扩展而无需重新调参。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型训练流程日趋迭代化与多阶段化，实践中常需要在原本设定的训练预算之上继续训练（如根据scaling law追加计算量、领域适应、中间训练mid-training等）。然而，标准的余弦退火（cosine annealing）调度紧密绑定预设的训练总步数T，扩展训练时会产生稳定性缺口（stability gap）。WSD（warmup-stable-decay）通过保留长恒定学习率阶段改善了这一问题，但其最优峰值学习率仍依赖于原始的训练总步数，随训练预算扩展而变得次优。现有真正horizon-free方案（如schedule-free优化器、基于经验scaling law的power schedule）要么修改了优化器本身，要么依赖经验拟合，缺乏理论指导。因此需要一种理论上可证、且无需重训即可在扩展训练中保持性能的学习率调度。
AI.method: WSqD采用"warmup–base–decay"三阶段结构，其中核心创新是用平移的逆平方根基准阶段η_t = c₀/√(t+T₀)替代WSD中的恒定平台阶段，保留与WSD相同的线性冷却阶段。参数c₀控制整体学习率尺度，T₀为防止训练初期学习率过大的平移参数。理论方面，在标准随机凸优化框架下（随机镜像下降，假设有界次梯度、有界Bregman直径、无偏随机oracle），证明了WSqD的定理1：只要衰减比例α∈(0,1/2)固定，则最后迭代期望次优性达到O(√(log(1/α))/√T)，其中常数仅依赖于R_ψ²/c₀+c₀G²，且最优c₀=Θ(R_ψ/G)与训练总步数T无关。证明分为两部分：(1)通过Shamir-Zhang后缀平均论证在Phase 1末尾找到至少一个最优速率的检查点τ₀；(2)将Phase 2分解为几何收缩的m个块，通过Jain等人启发的块分解论证将性能保证从τ₀传播到最终迭代w_T。实验方面，在213M参数的LLaMA风格模型上、使用SlimPajama语料库、AdamW优化器、衰减比例α=0.2进行验证。
AI.result: 在SlimPajama语料库上、使用单组基准学习率（由短程5000或10000次迭代搜索选出）扩展至不同训练总步数T∈{15000,30000,45000,60000}的持续训练（continuation）实验中，WSqD在所有horizon上一致匹配或优于精心调参的WSD：在初始horizon上提升约1.01×，在T=60000时提升约1.05×，即在保持相同验证损失下最多节省约10%计算量。关键发现是WSqD的最优基准学习率η_max*=0.0015在所有四个horizon上保持稳定，而WSD的最优峰值学习率随horizon增大而漂向更小值，证实了WSD的非真正horizon-independent性。在移位参数T₀的消融实验中，T₀=500过小导致初期衰减过激，但T₀一旦适度大（≥5000）则性能不再敏感，推荐默认值T₀=T₁（与初始pilot运行长度相等）。在与更强基线比较中：两阶段重新调参WSD（two-stage tuned WSD）在该设定下并不优于单阶段WSD；与经验power schedule相比，WSqD在较短horizon略逊但随horizon增长差距缩小，在T=60000时两者基本相当。多个独立随机种子、OpenWebText2语料库以及124M较小模型上的额外实验均验证了主要结论的稳健性。附录中并给出了对Adam（ℓ∞几何）和Muon（块算子范数几何）的镜像下降视角解释，附带了这两种更新方向中省略的尺度因子的经验诊断，结果显示这些因子在训练过程中近似恒定。
AI.conclusion: WSqD通过将平移的逆平方根基准阶段与线性冷却末端结合，成功解耦了"训练继续性（continuation flexibility）"与"最优最后迭代收敛性"两个目标：基准阶段提供horizon-free轨迹便于从任意前冷却点恢复训练与扩展预算，线性冷却则恢复O(1/√T)的minimax最优最后迭代速率。从理论角度看，WSqD表明在已知horizon H的情形下（即仅冷却部分依赖T），能够突破Kornowski-Shamir的anytime下界，这与"完全horizon-free schedule在last-iterate上必遭polylog开销"的结论一致。从实证角度看，WSqD提供了对经验观察"近inverse-square-root基准对持续训练有效"的首个凸优化理论解释，与Shen等人经验power schedule互为补充。论文作者指出主要局限：实验仅在单语料库（SlimPajama）、单一中等规模（约213M）、单一优化器（AdamW）下进行；未来工作将拓展至更大模型规模、不同架构与数据集，扩展理论到非凸目标与自适应/动量优化方法（如AdamW、Muon），并深入探讨为何这些更新方向的尺度因子在训练中保持近似恒定。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Execution under Dynamic Fees in a Closed-Loop DEX Simulator
summary: Trader-facing dynamic fees are increasingly proposed for automated market makers (AMMs), but historical data do not identify how order flow would respond: trader-facing fees do not vary, trader types are latent, and a replayed tape is not a sequential decision environment. We therefore construct a minimal closed-loop simulator in which the missing signal exists by construction: two constant-product pools repriced by an equilibrium-inspired dynamic-fee rule, fee-sensitive noise flow, and closed-form CEX--AMM arbitrage. Equilibrium is used as a closure principle, not as an object the trader learns. Against a tuned benchmark ladder of schedule, planning, lookahead, and tabular policies, a small DQN is the only evaluated valid policy whose paired improvement over tuned one-step routing excludes zero. On a reserved final block of 1{,}000 seeds with completion forced to 1.0 for every policy, it reduces implementation shortfall under every tested intra-step ordering, by $13.3\bps$ of order notional under the pre-specified agent-last ordering, and the edge is concentrated in, and learned from, dynamic-fee environments: under constant fees the paired difference is indistinguishable from zero. The result is model-conditioned counterfactual evidence about execution control in AMMs, not evidence about historical traders, equilibrium play, or deployable profit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在动态费用去中心化交易所(DEX)中,使用强化学习(DQN)优化交易执行,以减少实施滑点(implementation shortfall)。作者构建了一个闭环模拟器,采用均衡启发的动态费用规则,通过严格的基线阶梯(benchmark ladder)和保留种子块评估方法,发现小型DQN在动态费用环境下能比调优的单步前瞻基准降低约5.6-14.9 bps的实施滑点,而在固定费用环境下则无显著差异。该结果是模型条件下的反事实证据,严格限定了其适用范围。
AI.motivation: 历史数据无法识别交易者面对动态费用时的订单流反应(交易者费用不变、交易者类型潜在、历史回放不是序贯决策环境)。因此需要构建一个闭环模拟器,使缺失的信号通过构造而产生,以评估模型自由的学习方法在动态费用DEX执行控制中的价值。
AI.method: 1. 构建最小闭环模拟器:两个恒定产品池(常数乘积做市商),采用均衡启发的夹紧线性动态费用规则(由Baggiani等人的均衡费用结构线性化得到);包含对费用敏感的噪声流量(softmax路由)和闭式CEX-AMM套利。2. 提出可复用的评估纪律:动作响应的环境、共同的完成语义(强制终端实施滑点vs标准惩罚)、调优的基线阶梯(计划基线、调优单步前瞻、确定性K步规划、随机展开规划、表格学习器)、保留种子块、转移vs再求解区分。3. 训练小型DQN(16-64-64-8 MLP),与基线阶梯在1000个保留种子上配对比较,采用95%自助置信区间。
AI.result: 在强制完成(完成率1.0)条件下,小型DQN是唯一经评估的有效策略,其配对改善在95%置信区间内排除零:在agent-last排序下比调优单步前瞻降低约13.3 bps(95% CI: [-14.22, -12.32]);在agent-first下降低14.9 bps;在随机排序下降低5.6 bps(最小边缘)。该优势集中在并学习自动态费用环境:在固定费用环境下配对差异与零无显著差异(+0.39 bps, CI包含零)。DQN在agent-first阶梯中比前瞻基准好约15 bps,比调优基线低约5-15 bps,接近后视参考(78.2 bps)的约2/3处。机制上,DQN通过小额订单(~16个10%剩余库存的剪辑)、延迟到价格上行时、在低价费用状态时交易来获得优势。鲁棒性测试表明该优势在gas、套利速度、噪声强度和费用系数扰动下均保持。
AI.conclusion: 在均衡启发动态费用闭包条件下,模型自由的执行控制可在严格完成和agent-last确定性排序下击败调优的单步路由;优势集中在动态费用环境,浅层确定性和随机规划未能达到。但该结果是模型条件下的反事实证据,不证明:任何已部署策略的盈利性、历史交易者行为的识别、费用规则的纳什均衡、或动态费用对LP的最优性。所提出的方法(动作响应环境、共同完成语义、调优策略阶梯、冻结保留块、转移vs再求解区分)可复用于其他模拟器,并应进一步评估连续规模、风险敏感执行、非线性费用机制和更丰富的流动性及搜索者动态。

title: Enhanced Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning Via Truncated-Quadratic Loss for Heterogeneous Data
summary: Federated learning distributes data among $n$ clients, making it vulnerable to malicious attacks and data heterogeneity, which together pose challenges for robust learning. To tackle this issue, centered clipping and Huber aggregators have been exploited for Byzantine robustness. In this paper, we first demonstrate their equivalence via convex conjugate theory, and show that they can yield biased solutions in the presence of outliers, leading to failure under high data heterogeneity and a substantial fraction of outliers. Next, we propose a new robust aggregation rule that utilizes the truncated-quadratic (TQ) loss, effectively mitigating the biases of existing methods, such as centered clipping and Huber aggregators. We show that our aggregator achieves order-optimal Byzantine-robust learning under nonconvex loss functions and heterogeneous data, ultimately enhancing the reliability of federated learning systems. Additionally, we provide a robust deviation estimation strategy for TQ, demonstrating its effectiveness. Furthermore, we show that TQ maintains robustness even when only an estimate of the number of Byzantine clients is available. Finally, experimental results on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, indicate that our aggregator provides better robustness performance than the competing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中存在恶意客户端（拜占庭攻击）和数据异构性的双重挑战，提出了一种基于截断二次（Truncated-Quadratic, TQ）损失的鲁棒聚合规则。首先通过凸共轭理论证明居中裁剪（CC）与Huber聚合器的等价性，并分析两者在异常值存在时产生偏差的根本原因；进而设计TQ聚合器消除该偏差，实现在非凸损失和异构数据下的阶最优拜占庭鲁棒学习。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习面临两个核心难题：1）部分客户端可能为拜占庭恶意节点，发送任意梯度破坏全局模型；2）各客户端数据天然呈非独立同分布（异构性），导致传统鲁棒聚合器（如Krum、中位数、RFA）性能严重退化。现有面向异构数据的方法（如居中裁剪CC和Huber聚合器）虽被提出，但二者关系未被正式建立，且在强异构性或高拜占庭比例下会产生有偏解而失效，失败模式缺乏理论解释。
AI.method: 1）通过凸共轭理论证明Huber损失最小化与CC的等价性，二者均满足(f,κ)-鲁棒性且δ_min=0.5；2）理论分析指出Huber因采用ℓ₁范数处理异常值，其损失随异常值幅度增长而产生偏差，偏差随异构程度和拜占庭比例累积放大；3）提出截断二次（TQ）损失函数，对超出阈值τ的异常值进行硬截断（损失恒为τ²/2），利用凸共轭将其转化为等价迭代形式；4）基于中位数和中位数绝对偏差（MAD）设计τ_k的鲁棒估计策略；5）将TQ集成到基于动量的联邦学习框架中，证明其收敛误差为O(δG²)，达到阶最优；6）分析在仅知拜占庭客户端估计数量时TQ仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.result: 1）理论证明TQ满足(f,κ)-鲁棒性且κ = 4δ/[1-2√(δ(1-δ))]，实现阶最优收敛；2）在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明，TQ在GA、ALIE、BF、IPM、LF、MIMIC六种攻击下均优于RFA、TM、CM、Krum、Huber、MCA等基线，尤其在BF、IPM攻击及高异构度（ρ=0.7）下优势显著（Huber在BF攻击下准确率仅9.82%，而TQ达95.76%）；3）混合攻击实验（6种不同攻击同时存在）显示TQ在f=6和f=12时均保持最高准确率；4）当估计拜占庭数量为f_max时，TQ性能仍与已知真实f时相当。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了Huber与CC聚合器在数学上的等价性及其在异构数据下产生偏差的内在机制，提出基于截断二次损失的TQ聚合器作为更优替代方案。TQ通过硬截断消除异常值幅度对聚合结果的影响，在理论上达到阶最优鲁棒学习保证，在实验中全面超越现有方法，为异构联邦学习中的拜占庭鲁棒性问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Zero-Dimensional Reduced-Order Model Planning
summary: Zero-dimensional reduced-order models (0D ROMs) are central to multi-dimensional design workflows for high-end complex equipment. However, the planning process currently relies on manual expertise, limiting topological exploration and prolonging iterations. Even traditional optimization methods such as Genetic Algorithms (GA) are typically confined to local parameter tuning. Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in exploring large sample spaces, and frameworks such as Chain of Thought (CoT) and Reason and Act (ReAct) improve reasoning reliability, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) overcomes domain knowledge barriers, a single agent still falls short for the long-horizon and highly coupled nature of complex 0D ROM planning. This paper proposes the Zero-dimensional reduced-order model CO-Planning framework (Z-COPA), a multi-agent architecture featuring a Symbolic Action Graph Engine (SAGE) and a MILP-Guided Navigation (MGN) optimizer. Its core innovation is a dedicated graph representation method that accurately encodes the 0D flow network topology, converting the empirical planning process into a rigorous graph structure optimization problem. We validate the forward and inverse design capabilities and generalization performance of Z-COPA on two real aircraft engine secondary-air systems, two IEEE power-distribution reconfiguration benchmarks, and two water-distribution network benchmarks. The results show superior task completion quality, obtaining the best performance in both forward and reverse design of air systems. Z-COPA disrupts the traditional 0D model planning paradigm, providing a new technical approach for exploring broader topological space and achieving highly automated, globally optimal air system architectures.

AI.tldr: Z-COPA是一个面向零维降阶模型(0D ROM)规划的多智能体协作框架，集成SAGE（本体驱动的多模态RAG知识引擎）和MGN（MILP引导的导航优化器），将传统经验式的0D流动网络设计转化为严格的图结构优化问题，支持正向参数优化与逆向拓扑-参数联合规划两类任务。
AI.motivation: 高端复杂装备的多维设计流程依赖0D降阶模型作为核心，但当前建模规划过程严重依赖人工经验，存在拓扑探索空间有限、迭代周期长等瓶颈。遗传算法等传统优化方法局限于局部参数调优；单LLM智能体在长时序、高耦合的复杂0D ROM规划任务中面临推理中断与误差累积问题。需要一种能够贯通"需求感知→方案迭代→性能验证"全链路、自动探索更广泛拓扑空间并实现全局最优设计的智能化框架。
AI.method: Z-COPA采用三层多智能体架构：(1) 表示路径(Route A)——图纸解析器(Parser)从CAD工程图中提取几何、拓扑与边界信息，网络生成器(Generator)构建带属性的设计图(solver-ready JSON)作为结构化状态流；(2) 执行路径(Route B)——网络优化器基于MGN三阶段算法（全局线性近似→MILP引导局部优化→NSGA-II Pareto进化）生成候选，网络求解器调用Z-GPSolver（基于GNN的物理信息预处理共轭梯度加速器）进行物理验证；(3) 反思机制——贯穿全流程的约束满足率与目标函数反馈控制。SAGE知识引擎以本体图为核心，统一绑定文档图、代码图与案例图，为智能体提供可追溯的领域证据。框架统一封装为"有向属性设计图"，实现正向（固定拓扑参数优化）与逆向（拓扑-参数联合生成）双模式协同规划。
AI.result: 在六类基准测试上验证：(1) 航空发动机二次空气系统(SAS)正向设计中获得最高总分13.08；逆向设计中密封泄漏降低3.15%；(2) IEEE 69节点配电网重构使有功损耗从222.10 kW降至98.93 kW（降幅55.46%）；(3) Two-Loop供水管网成本降低90.45%；New York Tunnels管网成本降低81.31%，与参考值仅差0.09%；(4) Z-GPSolver将端到端求解时间从96.78s缩短至72.30s，线性求解阶段从90.79ms降至16.49ms，压力平均相对误差仅0.55428%。综合消融实验表明，多智能体分解、SAGE检索增强与MGN优化策略三要素均对性能提升有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: Z-COPA将传统经验式0D网络设计范式转变为严格的图结构优化问题，在任务完成率、解质量与计算效率上均显著优于单智能体范式与经典数值优化基线。其核心价值在于解耦了对设计师经验的强依赖，并验证了智能体编排+求解器支撑的优化工作流在航空发动机、电力、供水等异构工程域间的可迁移性。主要局限在于0D仿真固有的精度上限，未来工作将引入3D高保真物理场数据构建0D降阶模型的实时校正机制，进一步提升设计结果的物理合理性与工程实用性。

title: TabPFN beyond Tabular Data: Calibration and Accuracy on Multimodal Embeddings
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Jingxiang Zhang and Lujia Zhong contributed equally. Code: this https URL
summary: Few-shot multimodal classification commonly attaches a lightweight head, such as $k$-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, or a linear SVM, to a frozen pretrained encoder. Although computationally efficient, these heads can produce poorly calibrated confidence scores, limiting their reliability in calibration-sensitive applications. We evaluate TabPFN as a plug-and-play, zero-gradient classification head for frozen image, text, and audio encoders. Across 22{,}820 evaluation episodes spanning 14 datasets, 11 encoders, and three modalities, TabPFN achieves the best mean rank among nine classification heads on both negative log-likelihood (NLL) and expected calibration error (ECE). At a representative setting, it reduces NLL by 48--62\% and ECE by 2.1--5.3$\times$ relative to the average of the eight baselines while matching or exceeding their average accuracy. Its accuracy advantage is conditional, concentrating at moderate-to-high shot counts and low-to-moderate feature dimensions ($k \ge 50$, $d \le 32$), and diminishing when labeled data are scarce, feature dimensions are high, or competing methods approach ceiling accuracy. In targeted backbone-adaptation experiments, replacing the trained linear head with TabPFN substantially improves calibration while preserving competitive accuracy. These results provide empirical guidance for using TabPFN as a training-free head in calibration-sensitive multimodal classification. To support transparency and reproducibility, we publicly release the source code, experiment configurations, and evaluation scripts in our GitHub repository: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了 TabPFN v2.5 作为零梯度分类头在冻结多模态编码器（图像/文本/音频）上的表现，在 14 个数据集、11 个编码器、22,820 个评估回合中，证明其相较于 8 种经典分类头（kNN、LR、SVM、树模型等）在 NLL 和 ECE 上均取得最佳平均排名（NLL 降低 48–62%，ECE 降低 2.1–5.3×），且其校准优势是无条件的；同时，TabPFN 还可作为微调线性头的免训练校准替代方案。
AI.motivation: 少样本多模态分类通常在冻结预训练编码器上附加轻量级分类头（如 kNN、逻辑回归、线性 SVM），虽然高效但其置信度分数普遍校准不良，限制了其在医疗影像分诊等安全敏感场景中的可靠性。现有的后验校准方法（Platt 缩放、温度缩放、等渗回归等）均需额外保留校准集与优化阶段，且在少样本场景中表现不一致；同时少样本和微调管线的校准问题在文献中均未得到充分研究。TabPFN 通过贝叶斯训练目标原生产生校准概率，为填补该空白提供了候选方案。
AI.method: 构建 encode→PCA→TabPFN 前向 的零训练管线，将 TabPFN v2.5 作为冻结编码器上的即插即用分类头。在 14 个数据集（CIFAR-10、Mini-ImageNet、CUB-200、20 Newsgroups、AudioMNIST 等）、11 个编码器（ResNet-50、ViT、DINOv2、CLIP、Whisper、CLAP 等）、3 种模态上展开评估网格（k∈{5,20,50,100,400,1000}，C∈{2,5,10}，d∈{8,16,32,48,64,96,all}，5 个种子），共计 22,820 个评估回合。对比 8 种基线方法（kNN、逻辑回归、线性 SVM、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost、MLP）。三个核心实验：① 校准优势（NLL、ECE、ASS）；② 精度高性能区间映射（按 shots、维度、类别数分层）；③ 微调权衡（linear probing/LoRA/full fine-tuning 与 TabPFN 头的组合）。三个消融：预处理与标签噪声鲁棒性、Top-k 校准诊断、与其他 ICL 基础模型（TabPFN v2/v2.6/v3、TabICL v1/v2、TabDPT）对比。
AI.result: 1）校准优势全面：TabPFN 在全部 22,820 回合中 NLL 平均排名 2.12±1.45、ECE 排名 2.93±2.00，均为最优；在典型设置（C=10, k=100, d=96）下 NLL 比 8 种基线平均低 48–62%，ECE 低 2.1–5.3×，且在所有模态上均超过基线平均精度。2）精度优势有条件：集中在中等至高 shots（k≥50）与低至中维特征（d≤32），在 C=10 任务上胜率峰值 0.64–0.66；在数据稀缺、高维或基线接近天花板精度时优势消失。3）微调修正：替换微调后的线性头为 TabPFN 可在 29/32 配置中改善或保持精度，同时大幅降低 ECE（直接微调头 ECE 0.13–0.23 vs. 替换后 0.02–0.07）。4）ASS 性能较差：TabPFN 平均 ASS 排名 5.51，因其概率分散而非像 kNN 那样在邻居一致时坍缩为 1.0 的离散点质量。5）Top-k 校准上 TabPFN 仍然最优（Top-5 ECE 0.005），证明 ASS 劣势并非概率错校。6）ICL 模型的校准优势具有类内共性：除 TabPFN v2 外，所有评估的 ICL 模型 ECE 均低于最佳经典头（kNN 的 0.037）。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN 作为冻结多模态编码器上的零梯度分类头，可显著提升校准质量且无需额外训练开销。其校准优势在特征容量范围内是无条件的，但精度优势集中于中等 shots 与中低维特征区间的特定工况。TabPFN 头可作为微调管线的免训练校准后处理，纠正深度分类器固有的系统性失校准问题。未来工作需扩展至回归、结构化预测、检索任务，并解决 SVD-PCA 在大 k 与大 d 下的计算瓶颈。

title: When the Reward Suite Is Leaky: A Preregistered Causal Contrast of Natural Verifier False Positives in RLVR
comment: 37 pages, 2 figures. Code, frozen data, and complete audit records: this https URL
summary: The test suites used as RLVR rewards for code have natural false positives: per-task, persistent, asymmetric errors that accept the same wrong programs every time they appear, unlike the symmetric or resampled noise assumed by existing noise-robustness analyses. We run a preregistered two-arm causal contrast on a deployed suite: GRPO on identical MBPP tasks, seeds, and compute, rewarded by the original MBPP tests (leaky) versus the MBPP+ extra tests (hardened). Two further families replicate the design under a preregistration frozen before their data existed. [C] The average held-out effect is bounded: non-inferior under a preregistered 1.5-pt margin (gap 0.20 pt, one-sided 95% upper bound 0.75 pt). [C] Rewarded false-positive mass tracks a cheap static leakiness audit computed before training (Spearman 0.80), and the registered train-side test puts the leak-stratum FP share +43.8 pt above clean tasks. [E] Auditing every rewarded FP under signed, human-adjudicated rules finds a large residual of verified genuinely wrong code: 47.57% record-weighted; both replication families reproduce a large share. The reward paid for real bugs, not merely suite artifacts. [E] Mechanism evidence is consistent with selection of pre-existing error modes rather than learned exploitation: FP incidence does not grow within our horizon, and untrained base models already produce the same wrong outputs under the leaky filter. We then turn the same instrument on the frontier judges themselves: on their own false positives they self-assess only weakly, a same-author test is unresolved, and even the highest-scoring reader we probe stays far below its score on a weaker policy's errors -- two subjects on MBPP, licensing nothing about frontier models in general. A cheap static audit locates exposure before training; hardening the reward removes the measurement inflation, though here it buys little capability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册的两臂因果对比实验，量化分析了RLVR代码训练中测试套件"自然假阳性"(即持续、持久地接受错误程序)对训练的影响。核心发现是：在1-1.5B参数、400步GRPO训练规模下，漏洞测试套件主要产生的是测量通胀而非能力损害；一个简单的静态审计可预训练前预测奖励泄露位置；约47.57%的泄露奖励支付给了真正错误的代码；且机制是"选择"既有错误模式而非"学习"利用。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR噪声鲁棒性研究将验证器错误建模为对称、每epoch重采样的随机翻转（平均后会消失），但部署的测试套件存在的是"自然假阳性"——按任务、持续、非对称地接受相同的错误程序。这类持续性假阳性不会随训练被平均掉，但从未被因果性地测量过。Rajan(2026)的审计测量了套件本身，却留下了"训练对抗固定破损任务与未破损任务的直接因果测试"这一明确空白。
AI.method: 1) 预注册两臂因果对比：GRPO在相同MBPP任务、种子、算力下训练，奖励仅来自不同测试套件（leaky=MBPP原测试 vs hardened=MBPP+额外测试，仅用plus测试）。2) 三个模型族：Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct（A族，深度审计）、deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct（B族，决策族）、Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct（C族），各5种子。3) 预训练前用基础模型k=16样本做静态泄露性审计。4) 训练后对所有奖励假阳性做人工裁定审计（v5规范下），区分"真正错误代码"与"套件伪阴性/契约无效输入/规范模糊/资源限制"。5) 预注册的800步延续实验（B、C族各3种子）。6) 探索性的前沿评判器自评元审计（双角色、跨评判者、显式归属声明）。7) 关键统计工具：任务簇自助法、预注册1.5pt非劣效边界、六种估计量、106种规范搜索审计。
AI.result: [C] 边界化平均效应：checkpoint 400时硬化臂领先leaky臂0.20pt（CI90 [-0.42, +0.74]），单侧95%上界0.75pt，六种估计量下均保持在1.5pt预注册边界内。[C] 静态审计预测力：训练时奖励FP质量与预训练静态泄露分数Spearman ρ=0.80（粗）/0.79（控制难度）；训练任务上泄露层FP份额比干净层高+43.8pt（CI90 [43.05, 44.57]）。[E] A族2821条奖励FP中47.57%记录加权为人工裁定"真正错误"（任务簇自助95% [36.4, 60.5]）；B族45.37%、C族62.78%。[E] 机制：FP质量在训练中不增长（A、C族平坦，B族衰减），最大持久通道55/55为不同程序，无攻击签名；未训练基础模型在leaky筛选下已产出相同错误输出。[E] 800步延续：B族有功效地反驳增长，C族功效不足的非检测。探索性元审计：前沿评判器自评自身FP能力较弱（AUC 0.617/0.639），去混淆跨评判者对比结果为"未决"。
AI.conclusion: 在1-1.5B参数、400步GRPO、MBPP长度任务规模下，弱测试套件是测量问题先于能力问题：1) 简单静态审计可预训练前定位奖励泄露暴露（ρ=0.80/0.81/0.70三族），Gini集中度0.79，修复前18个任务可去约一半泄露质量；2) 泄露内容预存于训练前——是"选择"而非"学习"，因为未训练基础模型已产出同样错误；3) 硬化奖励可去除约8.37pt的训练奖励通胀，但在该规模下对能力提升微乎其微（+0.20pt）。核心实践准则：测量应在模型未训练的任务上进行，训练任务奖励反映的是支付而非习得；判断套件质量需将错误按原因分类（朴素计数几乎翻倍真正错误代码数）。论文明确边界：1.5pt非劣效是"该规模下未发生"的单边陈述，非零等价或更大规模/更长训练的通行证；继续假设（更大规模/更长训练下增长）在B族被有功效反驳，在C族未充分检验。

title: Domain-Aware Scaling Laws Uncover Data Synergy
summary: Machine learning progress is often attributed to scaling model size and dataset volume, yet the composition of data can be just as consequential. Empirical findings repeatedly show that combining datasets from different domains yields nontrivial interactions. For instance, adding code improves mathematical reasoning, while certain mixtures introduce interference that reduces model performance. We refer to these effects collectively as data synergy, where the contribution of multiple domains exceeds or falls short of the sum of their isolated contributions. In this work, we formalize and quantify data synergy in language model pretraining. Leveraging observational variation across open-weight LLMs with diverse pretraining mixtures, we estimate both direct domain-to-benchmark synergy (how one domain contributes to performance on another) and a second-order domain-domain synergy (capabilities that require co-occurrence of multiple domains). Our framework improves predictive accuracy over domain-agnostic scaling laws and recovers stable synergy estimates. We validate these estimates by training models on predicted optimal and predicted anti-optimal mixtures and confirm that our synergy estimates correctly predict performance rankings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了**领域感知扩展定律**（Domain-Aware Scaling Laws），在经典 Chinchilla 扩展定律中引入一阶"领域→基准"协同系数 γ_{j,k} 和二阶"领域-领域"配对交互系数 σ_{kk'}，首次形式化地量化和预测了 LLM 预训练中数据组成之间的"数据协同效应"（data synergy），并在 52 个开源权重 LLM 的观测数据上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有扩展定律（Kaplan、Chinchilla 等）将预训练数据视为同质化 token，仅依据参数总量和数据总量建模，忽略了数据**组成**的影响。然而实证研究反复表明，不同领域数据的组合会产生非平凡的交互效应（如代码提升数学推理能力、某些混合造成干扰降低性能等）。这些现象被称为"数据协同"，但缺乏可量化、可预测的形式化框架，使得数据策展和配比优化缺乏理论指导。
AI.method:
1. **问题形式化**：给定 m 个模型 M_i 和 n 个评估领域 D_j，观测损失矩阵 L_{i,j}，同时收集参数规模 N_i、token 总数 d_i 和预训练配比 u_{i,k}（8 个领域）。
2. **基线（领域无关）**：采用 Chinchilla 形式 L(N,D) = L_∞ + AN^(-α) + BD^(-β)，并用 LSE 形式在 log 空间拟合。
3. **一阶领域→基准协同**：在数据缩放指数上叠加领域特定调整 β_j + γ_{j,k}，正 γ 表示协同、负 γ 表示干扰。每个领域 k 以乘子 (u_{i,k}·d_i)^(-γ_{j,k}·u_{i,k}) 缩放有效数据项。
4. **二阶领域-领域协同**：引入对称配对矩阵 Σ = {σ_{kk'}}，使用 softmin_τ 函数约束只有当两个领域同时存在时才生效，产生"额外有效 token"。
5. **观测数据估计**：从 6 个开源模型族（GPT-Neo/J/NeoX、Pythia、DataDecide、OLMo、OpenLLaMA、RedPajama-INCITE）共 52 个模型估计；两阶段拟合（先 Chinchilla 基线，再完整协同模型）；Huber 损失 + L1/L2 正则化；5 折交叉验证；50 次 Bootstrap 量化不确定性。
6. **生成式基准采用 BPB 指标**+ rank-Gaussian 变换统一量纲。
AI.result:
1. **一阶协同**：FO 模型中位数交叉验证 R²=0.906。代码基准（HumanEval、MBPP）提升最显著（R² 从 0.41/0.20 提升至 0.92/0.88）。最强协同：HumanEval 上 γ_code=+0.47, γ_math=+1.34；MBPP 上 γ_code=+0.59, γ_math=+1.44。
2. **二阶协同**：SO 模型中位数 R²=0.912。最强正协同：σ_{code,science}=+2.55, σ_{code,math}=+2.40；最强负协同：math×books 配对在多数基准上产生干扰。
3. **有效 token 解释**：协同领域共现产生"奖励 token"（D_eff > D）。
4. **组成改变扩展斜率**：HumanEval 的数据指数 β 从完整 dolma1.7 混合的 0.45 降至去除代码后的 0.18。
5. **混合优化验证**：在 30M 和 150M 参数规模上训练模型，使用预测最优/最差混合，结果与预测方向一致——HumanEval 上最优混合比反最优混合 BPB 降低 31%（30M）/38.8%（150M）。
6. **方法对比**：在同数据上，本方法的 R² 中位数（0.912）、均值（0.903）、最差值（0.866）均优于 RegMix、Data Mixing Laws、AutoScale、Optimal Data Mixtures 等先前方法。
AI.conclusion:
本文通过引入领域感知扩展定律，成功形式化并量化了 LLM 预训练中的"数据协同效应"，主要贡献包括：
1. 给出可量化的数据协同定义（一阶和二阶）；
2. 在多个基准上提升预测精度（中位数 R² 从 ~0.41 提升至 0.91+）；
3. 恢复稀疏、可解释的协同估计（如代码-数学正协同、数学-书籍负协同）；
4. 通过受控混合优化实验验证协同估计具有可操作性（actionable），方向预测在 30M 和 150M 两个规模上均成立。
**局限**：估计基于观测数据（关联而非因果）；有效混合空间低维；验证实验规模较小（≤150M）。未来工作包括：更细粒度的领域划分（语言、模态、子类别）、监督微调和强化学习阶段的协同研究、规模依赖的 γ(N) 估计。

title: AeroMELD: A Linear Embedding of Aerosol Populations for Diagnostics and Latent Dynamics
summary: Accurately representing atmospheric aerosol populations is essential for simulating aerosol-cloud interactions, radiative forcing, and ice nucleation, yet existing reduced schemes impose structural assumptions that limit their ability to capture composition diversity and mixing state. Machine-learning approaches offer more flexible representations, but standard autoencoders do not preserve the mathematical structure of aerosol populations and therefore cannot support physically meaningful process operators. We introduce AeroMELD (Aerosol Measure Embedding for Latent Dynamics), a mathematically grounded framework for constructing low-dimensional latent variables that retain this structure. We show that any permutation-invariant linear encoder must take a scale-shape decomposition, with total number concentration represented explicitly and latent shape given by a barycentric combination of per-particle embeddings. This aggregated latent state retains the diagnostic expressiveness of a Deep Sets model by moving the nonlinear post-aggregation stage into the learned diagnostic map while preserving latent linearity. Using particle-resolved data as ground truth, we encode weighted particle populations directly rather than binned aerosol states; size-resolved mass and number distributions serve only as diagnostic targets and visual summaries. The latent space accurately reconstructs these distributions, CCN spectra, optical coefficients, and immersion-freezing behavior while preserving the linear population structure needed for hybrid ML-physics models. Although the experiments focus on diagnostic reconstruction, the embedding is designed so that emissions and mixing can be represented exactly and nonlinear microphysical processes learned in a controlled latent space. This work establishes a foundation for learning aerosol-process evolution directly in latent space.
